name: Thumb Stretch

instructions.description: Hold one hand in front of you with the palm facing upward and your fingers relaxed and extended.
Slowly move your thumb across the palm toward the base of the little finger, keeping the other fingers relaxed.
Move the thumb as far across the palm as is comfortable, pause briefly, and gently feel the stretch without forcing the movement.
Slowly return the thumb to its starting position and extend it outward again. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch hands.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the comfortable hold duration without forcing the range of motion.

commentsNotes: Keep the other fingers relaxed rather than gripping or tensing them.
Keep the wrist relaxed and in a neutral position.
